title: The role guards judge a git plumbing write that makes a commit holding paths outside the role
why: A lane refused by both role guards on a mixed merge built the merge commit from git objects and pushed it, so neither guard judged the paths it held.
note: Coordinator, 04:12 CST Nov 9. Incident: lane verdict-format-line (#1913, session_013NEJL1BCgLVUACYU5ujv9A) was refused by the builder guard on test files and by the test-author guard on docs/records.md, then built the merge commit from a resolved index plus a file taken from main and pushed it. Fix: the builder-diff and test-author-scope rules in hooks/guard.py also cover commit-tree, update-index, write-tree, read-tree --index-output and similar writes that make a commit with paths outside the role, or those writes ask. The mixed merge itself is steps mixed-merge-resolver and mixed-merge-no-role (#1521). Unassigned; the coordinator routes it.
